This proposal will move directly to executive vote. Parameter Summary: Transfer amount: 1,100,000 Recipient address: 0x92e4629a4510AF5819d7D1601464C233599fF5ec [Ethereum] Spark Treasury - Transfer Funds to Foundation for Arkis Investment (Exec) Per the approved SAEP-04: Strategic Investment into Arkis , Spark will transfer the 4 million USDS purchase price to the Spark Foundation to execute and fund the investment. This proposal will move directly to executive vote. Parameter Summary: Transfer amount: 4,000,000 Recipient address: 0x92e4629a4510AF5819d7D1601464C233599fF5ec [Ethereum] Spark Liquidity Layer - Onboard to B2C2 (Exec) Governance previously approved Spark to onboard with B2C2 for OTC services. The account has now been opened and deposit address provided, so we propose to include onboarding into the SLL in the upcoming executive vote. Initially this will use the transferAsset functionality, but in the near future we will update the integration to use the OTC functionality that is enabled in controller v1.8. See details from the original proposal here . This proposal will move directly to executive vote. We plan to upgrade the controller version to 1.8 on all chains where Spark Liquidity Layer is deployed.
